description: This file defines the CustomerController class within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes customer service traits to prepare a customer list component for rendering, including unselectable customer IDs.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling customer-related views within the Time plugin, rendering a customer list with unselectable customer IDs.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and components for rendering the customer list, including fetching unselectable customer IDs and setting up the Vue component.
